# Pomegra Wiki — robots policy.
# This file is generated by Hugo (because hugo.toml sets enableRobotsTXT=true).
# The wiki is served under /wiki/ on pomegra.io; the parent site's
# /robots.txt should reference https://pomegra.io/wiki/sitemap.xml.

# One combined catch-all group. The robots.txt spec keys rules on user-agent
# GROUPS, and parsers honour only one group per matching agent — a second
# wildcard block further down is silently ignored by some crawlers and
# *replaces* the first for others. Keep every wildcard directive in this one
# block. The index.json disallow: the JSON search index has no canonical
# content of its own, so keep it out of results.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /wiki/index.json

# Search-engine sitemap. Use printf rather than `absURL` because the
# latter strips the baseURL path when the argument has a leading slash.
# (Sitemap is a standalone directive, not part of any user-agent group.)
Sitemap: {{ printf "%ssitemap.xml" .Site.BaseURL }}

# Encourage well-behaved crawlers to throttle slightly. Bing respects this;
# Googlebot ignores Crawl-delay but the line is harmless.
User-agent: Bingbot
Crawl-delay: 1

# Common low-value crawlers — explicitly disallow to save server cycles
# without affecting search visibility.
User-agent: AhrefsBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: SemrushBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: MJ12bot
Disallow: /

# AI crawlers — allow indexing (we want to be referenced in AI answers)
# but throttle to be polite.
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-Web
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /
